integrity: The proof is self-contained using the seven-line incidence axioms, elementary simplicial collapses, fundamental-group contractions, and signed Lefschetz traces. Exact finite checks are provided; no external independent validation was performed.
limitations: Specific to the binary Fano projective plane and its point-line nonincidence graph; does not extend to higher orders, classify point-line-duality actions, or establish integral saturation of the 21 homology images.
title: Induced homotopy and symmetry in the Fano nonincidence neighborhood complex
